resolution: Acquire CGA annual report or detailed CGE supporting tables before marking the ledger complete
Acquire payroll withholding totals and CGA quota revenue split before testing whether deducted amounts were fully remitted
Acquire employer-class payroll bases and CGA employer-contribution revenue split before computing legal or economic gaps
Acquire public employment new-entrant cohorts by year and perimeter before estimating post-2006 RGSS reallocation
Acquire cohort counts contribution bases and RGSS legal rates before computing mechanical reallocation flows
Acquire bank-level transfer schedules valuation reports or public-account annexes before computing transaction-at-inception ledger values
Acquire pension cash-flow schedules and defensible mortality/longevity inputs before computing discount-rate sensitivity
Acquire annual Conta da Seguranca Social or DGO execution tables with RSB transfer expenditure and financing detail before classifying residuals
Acquire bank-level transfer valuation reports audited fund asset schedules and retained-liability valuations before estimating net benefit or subsidy
Acquire official ESA-95 and ESA-2010 national-accounts or EDP restatement tables before marking the reclassification independently reproduced
